tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation rejects the fitted ODE, so its archived four-parameter fit is not adequate. The existing rows all have s_grad=0, leaving gradient-dependent siphon or branch mechanisms untested; the open-branch probe is the most informative available next measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise the coupled memory-kernel ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its fresh confirmation RMSE (0.353) is far above tolerance, and current rows do not distinguish a faulty memory initialization from another mechanism.
The evidence refutes the submitted model but does not show chaotic sign oscillations or refutation of all stationary smooth mechanisms.
More trajectories at the same low-gradient regime are less informative than probing the untested gradient/branch dependence.
